name: gantt
title: Gantt
description: A plan laid out against dates: tasks down, days across, under a sticky two-tier header (months over days or weeks, years over months) beside a sticky name column with Table's look. Each task is a bar on the raised plate with Progress's well inside, a milestone a diamond, today a line with NOW. Press a bar and it lifts and follows the hand while its slot, snapped to whole days, shows as a recess; it lands there. Its ends resize a day at a time. Keys move it a day, Shift its end, Alt Shift its start, said in a polite status. A failed save puts the dates back.
docs: Agent guide: https://metalui.dev/r/gantt.md. SwiftUI: MetalGantt in the MetalUI Swift package.
